data.name: Mafia Business Simulator
data.detailed_description:
Step into the world of organized crime in Mafia Business Simulator, where power isn’t taken by force alone. It's built through strategy, control, and smart decisions. 🕴️

In modern London, every street is an opportunity, every rival is a threat, and every move shapes your rise to power.

💼 Build Your Criminal Empire

Run a network of underground businesses, from illegal trade to digital operations. Grow your income, expand your reach, and turn small operations into a powerful empire.

🗺 Control the City

Take over territories, manage influence, and secure your position across London. The city is divided, and it’s up to you to dominate it.

🏢 Live Your Headquarters

Walk through your base in first-person, observe your operations in action, and interact with your key lieutenants as your empire grows.

⚔️ Outsmart Rival Syndicates

You’re not alone in the underworld. Compete against rival groups, plan your moves carefully, and stay one step ahead in a constant fight for control.

📈 Every Decision Matters

There are no random outcomes. Your success depends on how well you plan, manage, and adapt.

In Mafia Business Simulator, crime is more than action - it’s strategy, control, and power.
